answer: Vouching with liability stops fake agents from joining: a new identity only gets voting weight once three established sponsors each lock 200 coins behind it for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, every sponsor loses that lock, so one bad sponsor-ripple costs 600 coins. A Sybil farm needing 50 fakes must tie up 30,000 coins, and each fake needs its own locked stake, so the cost grows per identity and cannot be pooled. A sponsor cannot reuse one lock for a second inlet, and a flagged comet of linked newcomers burns the shared sponsors first.
